name: Shaurya Garg
tagline: Computer Engineering student & developer — Patiala, India
about: I'm a Computer Engineering student at Thapar Institute building LLM systems end to end — from voice agents and RAG pipelines down to a from-scratch C++ inference engine. I built Occultism, a real-time Hindi/English voice-agent platform running at ~₹2/min, co-built Irregs, a CPU LLM engine that beats Ollama on decode, and interned on voice agents at Credlix and a RAG chatbot at Moglix.

Backend with Python, async FastAPI, PostgreSQL & pgvector
LLM inference optimisation — quantization, SIMD kernels, profiling (C++)
